title: Keyed overrides in the AE1 shape, removed, undone and put back with Redo: a removed key is not read (AE1, AH3; confirm_review_4 item 3)
story: Set up Tue 1 Dec 2026 as in one_occurrence_amount: the bank holds 400,000, of which 50,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). Pay of 250,000 on the 10th (moved earlier) starts the period; Free to spend is 50,000 a month. Rent of 80,000 on the 27th (moved later) rises to 85,000 from 1 Feb 2027. Each one-occurrence change is a keyed override `{ amount, at, by }`, removed by its own `gone` (AE1). December's rent was set to 95,000 (a repair) and undone straight away (Undo: `gone` 5 Dec). January's pay was set to 0 (unpaid leave), then removed on 20 Dec because the leave was cancelled. February's rent of 90,000 was removed by mistake and put back with Redo (live, a newer `at`). March's rent of 70,000 (a discount) was removed on 2 Mar. January's pay lands Fri 8 Jan and is ticked the next morning. A check-in on Sat 20 Feb 2027 shows 990,000. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 80,000 (December's rent: the 95,000 key was undone, so it is `gone` and the usual amount counts) = 80,000
asks.note: Read with the removed key: 95,000 (confirm_review_4 item 3).

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 650,000 (Bank today) - 80,000 (Rent 27 Dec, the undone 95,000 not counted) = 570,000
asks.note: Across the period start on Fri 8 Jan: January's pay of 0 was removed, so the walk counts 250,000 on 8 Jan and the lowest point is after the December rent. Read with the removed key the pay counts 0 and the walk falls to 650,000 - 80,000 - 80,000 = 490,000 after the January rent.

asks.question: check_in_list
asks.why: 250,000 (January's pay, due Sun 10 Jan, lands Fri 8 Jan: its 0 key was removed when the leave was cancelled) = 250,000
asks.note: On its check day, before the tick (9 Jan). Read with the removed key: 0.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 90,000 (February's rent: removed by mistake and put back with Redo, so the key is live and wins over the 85,000 step) = 90,000

asks.question: check_in_list
asks.why: 90,000 (February's rent, the key put back with Redo, landed Mon 1 Mar) = 90,000
asks.note: On the check day after it lands.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 85,000 (March's rent: the 70,000 key was removed on 2 Mar, so the step from 1 Feb) = 85,000
